channel.desc: Briony May Williams heads for the glorious Peak District, helping a Canadian couple spend up to ?475,000 on a new home for them and their dog, Verona. The mystery house delivers jaw-dropping views, and Briony meets some park rangers who keep this stunning landscape in tip-top shape, including octogenarian Margaret who still volunteers on the hills.
